spots.name: Selimiye Mosque
spots.summary: The Selimiye Mosque is an Ottoman imperial mosque, located in the city of Edirne, Turkey. It was commissioned by Sultan Selim II and was built by the imperial architect Mimar Sinan between 1568 and 1575.

spots.name: Rüstem Pasha Caravanserai
spots.summary: Rüstem Pasha Caravanserai is a caravanserai located in Edirne, northwestern Turkey, commissioned by Ottoman statesman and grand vizier Rüstem Pasha and built by court architect Mimar Sinan in 1561. The building is used today as a hotel with 110 rooms, the interior having been remodelled in 2016–18.

spots.summary: The Grand Synagogue of Edirne, also known as the Adrianople Synagogue, is a synagogue, located in Maarif Street, Edirne, in the Marmara region of Turkey.

spots.name: Meriç Bridge
spots.summary: Meriç Bridge, a.k.a. Yeni Köprü, meaning New Bridge or Mecidiye Bridge, after Sultan Abdülmecid I, is a historic Ottoman bridge in Edirne, Turkey. It crosses the Meriç river, formerly carrying the state road D.100, connecting Pazarkule border gate through Karaağaç to Edirne. It has since been bypassed by Dr.

spots.name: Darülhadis Mosque

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Darülhadis Mosque, a mosque in Edirne, Turkey. It was built in 1435 by Murad II on the banks of the Tunca River. There has been debate as to whether the structure was built as a mosque or a madrasa, and various opinions exist. During the Balkan Wars, its minaret was destroyed by Bulgarian artillery fire.
